mapper.sql: FROM editing_task t JOIN sys_user c ON t.created_by=c.id JOIN sys_user e ON t.assignee_id=e.id JOIN sys_user r ON t.reviewer_id=r.id
mapper.select: SELECT AND AND (t.assignee_id=#{auth.userId} OR t.reviewer_id=#{auth.userId}) AND t.title LIKE CONCAT('%',#{q.keyword},'%') AND t.status=#{q.status}AND t.priority=#{q.priority} AND t.assignee_id=#{q.assigneeId}AND t.reviewer_id=#{q.reviewerId} ORDER BY t.due_atCASE t.priority WHEN 'LOW' THEN 1 WHEN 'NORMAL' THEN 2 WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 3 ELSE 4 ENDt.created_at ASC DESC ,t.id DESC
